title.value: A Heat Diffusion Perspective on Geodesic Preserving Dimensionality Reduction
title.justification: The title is provided explicitly at the beginning of the paper and reflects the core topic discussed.
title.quote: A Heat Diffusion Perspective on Geodesic Preserving Dimensionality Reduction

extractions.description: This paper discusses diffusion-based manifold learning methods, aiming to connect heat diffusion to manifold distances via Riemannian geometry. It introduces 'heat geodesic embeddings' for enhanced dimensionality reduction, outperforming previous methods in maintaining geodesic distances and data structure.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on mathematical and computational methods for data representation and dimensionality reduction, without a direct emphasis on climate or ecological impacts.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Diffusion-based manifold learning methods have proven useful in representation learning and dimensionality reduction of modern high dimensional, high throughput, noisy datasets.
